description: Volatility, change and range for up to 20 instruments in ONE call. A separate tool from price.stats, for the same pricing reason as price.bundle. Returns the same derived statistics over the full retained history per instrument, with per-instrument errors rather than a whole-call failure when one has no history. Paid; charged only if at least one instrument resolves.

windows.description: Lookback windows, e.g. ["30d", "90d", "1y"]. Defaults to those three.

name: stats.bundle
title: Statistics for Several Instruments
